newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Forrestania reports rich nickel find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Forrestania reports rich nickel find.

text.p: Forrestania Gold NL said on Thursday assays from the Emily Ann prospect at the Roundtop joint venture in Western Australia included one interval of 1.08 metres grading 9.0 percent nickel at a depth of 213.3 metres.
The same hole encountered, within a second zone, 5.8 metres grading 6.3 percent nickel at a depth of 231.7 metres including 3.34 metres at 9.1 percent nickel from 234.1 metres, it said.

It said these results are higher than those reported on Wednesday by its 25 percent joint venture partner Capricorn Resources Australia NL. The other joint venture partner is South African-based mining house Gencor Ltd.
The results were from the second of two step-out diamond drill holes near the big Maggie Hays nickel find.
"Drilling is continuing at Emily Ann to further test this significant new discovery," Forrestania's managing director Barry Eldridge said in a statement.
Forrestania is currently under a scrip and cash takeover offer from Lionore Mining International Ltd of Canada, which values Forrestania shares at A$3.35 each.
At 3.10 p.m. (0410 GMT), Forrestania shares were two cents lower at A$2.92, while Capricorn shares were 7.5 cents up at 30 cents.
